$comment: How the robot reaches each PMS report. No secrets here (the username and password are GitHub secrets). 'menu' is the path clicked in the PMS menu; a report runs on schedule only once its 'export' button is set. In 'steps', {from} and {to} become the report's dates in 'dateFormat'.

login.user: input[type=text], input[type=email], input[name*=user i], input[id*=user i]
login.submit: button[type=submit], input[type=submit], button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign in'), button:has-text('دخول')
